features.title: Everything you need

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From registration to stage in 4 steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Sign up as a musician or venue. Add your details and preferences.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Musicians enable availability, venues post gig offers.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Our AI engine ranks the best matches by distance, genre and style.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Accept a gig, arrange details on chat and hit the stage.
